tools.name: find_services
tools.description: Find community and social services (food banks, shelters, counselling, legal aid, income help and 18 more needs) in a Canadian community on navigi.ca. Every row carries the public page URL and the date the listing's own website was last checked; cite the URL and the date.

tools.name: services_near
tools.description: Community and social services within a radius of a point, optionally for one need. Use when the person gives a location rather than a community name.

tools.name: get_community
tools.description: One community's listing counts by category and its page URL on navigi.ca.

tools.name: list_needs
tools.description: The service categories navigi.ca uses, with the searcher terms each one answers. Call this first when unsure which need word to use.
